text: You have a right to perform your prescribed duties, but you are not entitled to the fruits of your actions. Never consider yourself the cause of the results of your activities, nor be attached to inaction.
One must deliver himself with the help of his mind, and not degrade himself. The mind is the friend of the conditioned soul, and his enemy as well.

One who is not envious but is a kind friend to all living entities, who does not think himself a proprietor and is free from false ego, who is equal in both happiness and distress — such a devotee is very dear to Me.
Whenever there is a decline in righteousness and an increase in unrighteousness, O Arjuna, at that time I manifest Myself on earth to protect the righteous and to destroy evil.
Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender unto Me. I shall deliver you from all sinful reactions. Do not fear.
The wise man beholds all beings in the Self, and the Self in all beings; for that reason he does not hate anyone.
Words that are truthful, beneficial, and not agitating to others, and the regular recitation of scriptures — these are said to be austerity of speech.
He is a perfect yogi who, by comparison to his own self, sees the true equality of all beings, in both their happiness and their distress, O Arjuna.

Fearlessness, purification of one's existence, cultivation of spiritual knowledge, charity, self-control, sacrifice, study of the Vedas, austerity, and simplicity — these are the transcendental qualities born of divine nature.
If one offers Me with love and devotion a leaf, a flower, fruit or water, I will accept it.
